mkm.text: Ezrim leads the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations, a truth cult he transformed into the Agency after the Phyrexian Invasion, and at Karlov Manor he honors Investigator Kellan's team for stopping the god Anzrag's rampage.
When Zegana is assassinated, he is present and assists the investigation, and he offers Kaya leadership of it, but she refuses and walks away.
After Teysa is found dead, Kaya returns and tells him Teysa Karlov has been murdered, and Ezrim gives her the position, telling her to begin with Judith and assigning Kellan to accompany her.
He later tells Kaya that Teysa's killer has been caught by the Azorius but remembers nothing, and when Anzrag breaks free, he challenges the god in the Agency.
In the end, at Vitu-Ghazi, Proft reveals that Oba organized the murders, and Oba captures Ezrim, who is freed when Kaya and Etrata defeat her.
